slides.texte_overlay:
Things you should stop
doing as a boyfriend
Stop making plans only when she asks. Suggest a date, book the table, pick the film. Taking initiative shows she's a priority, not something you fit in between other plans.
Stop being on your phone when she talks. Put it away, look at her, ask a second question. Feeling heard by you matters more to her than any gift you'll ever buy.
Stop getting defensive at every complaint. Listen first, then answer. "You're right, I didn't think about that" ends more arguments than winning ever will.
Stop forgetting the small things she tells you. Her exam, her friend's birthday, the show she loves. Remembering details is how love really shows up day to day.
Before: same conversations every evening. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and something new to share with her every single night at dinner.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: same conversations every evening. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Now I bring something new each night.

slides.texte_overlay: Stop expecting her to read your mind. Say what you feel and what you need. Clear, calm communication beats silent frustration in every single relationship you'll ever have.
Stop letting the effort fade. The compliments, the surprises, the little notes. Keep doing what you did at the beginning, because she still deserves all of it.
